text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened when I stopped by an amusement park,
having been invited by Satono Crown.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"That ride earlier was so much fun~!
Though next, I'd like something even more thrilling."
choice_data_list: How about that haunted house over there?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Tai ha sin?
...Ooh~! It really has quite the atmosphere!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "Those with weak hearts should refrain"...
choice_data_list: It's so terrifying that they say there's a 100% scream rate...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Screaming is the best part of horror! It's so refreshing♪

text_block_list.name: Creepy Receptionist
text_block_list.text:
Hee-hee-hee... Please be careful.
They say it falls upon the guests
who make it across the goal.

text_block_list.name: Creepy Receptionist
text_block_list.text: A truly terrifying "curse"...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Eep? A curse...
choice_data_list: I hope it's a curse that lets me scream a lot!
I hope it's a curse that lets you scream a lot!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, you're right!
Let's shout all we want and let it all out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The air inside the building was gloomy, heavy, and chilly...
Relying on the faint light, I crept forward timidly—

text_block_list.name: Zombie
text_block_list.text: VOOOAAARRRGHHH~~!!
choice_data_list: It's heeeeeeere!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True, screaming really does clear the mind!
I'm sure Satono Crown is having fun too...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Every phenomenon has its rules...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
It's not an insurmountable wall...
No problem, no problem...
choice_data_list: …Huh? Crown?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Wah?! ...Ah, yeah, it's nothing.
Let's keep going.

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired Woman
text_block_list.text: D-Don't leave me behiiiind...!!
choice_data_list: Eeeeeeeeek?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "If I analyze this carefully, I'm sure to find a winning strategy... Stay calm, keep cool..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even after that, Satono Crown never let out a single scream...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
W-We're almost at the finish line, aren't we...?
............The finish line...
choice_data_list: ...Um, Crown?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ! Oh, is something wrong? If it's about the way we're going, it's definitely this wa—
choice_data_list: No, it's just that you look pale.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With every step, she looks like she's running out of steam.
If she isn't feeling well,
she really ought to pull out here.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Huh? Did I look unwell...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... It's hopeless.
Whenever that comes up, her vision gets so narrow.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: You know, Trainer. There really is nothing wrong with my health. It's just...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Ghosts aside... When it comes to "curses" and stuff like that... I'm a bit, you know...
choice_data_list: In that case, all the more reason you should retire...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
No, I'll see this through to the end.
I don't want to run away from facing it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "...When I was little, you know, there was a dog I used to run into a lot at the park."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
He was big and barked all the time.
To me back then, he was like a monster.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Eventually, even that park became scary to me... But I didn't want things to stay like that, so I gathered my courage and walked closer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Gradually getting used to each other, our distance shrank...
and in the end, we started playing together.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
In life, if you keep being scared of the things that scare you,
you'll miss out on things you could have gained.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: That's why I want to take on the challenge right here, right now.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
To overcome fear,
you have no choice but to face its source—...!
choice_data_list: ...Understood. Let's head further in together!
I'll blow any curse right away!
I'll blow any curse right away!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
To overcome fear,
you have no choice but to face its source—...!
choice_data_list: ...Understood. Let's head further in together!
I'll blow any curse right away!
I'll blow any curse right away!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Mmh-goi yi-si ah, Trainer!
Don't worry, I spent the whole way here thinking through every possible countermeasure!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—Finally, the goal.
Beyond this lies the curse...
choice_data_list: Alright, let's go...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ! Ahaha, I wonder why.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
When you say it, I feel like everything will be okay.
...I'm counting on you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—Finally, the goal.
Beyond this lies the curse...
choice_data_list: Alright, let's go...!

text_block_list.name: Creepy Receptionist
text_block_list.text: You have done well to make it this far...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: You're... the receptionist...!

text_block_list.name: Creepy Receptionist
text_block_list.text:
Lastly, let me present you with a cursed artifact.
A curse that will never let you escape this mansion...!!

text_block_list.name: Creepy Receptionist
text_block_list.text:
“—And so! Here are some discount
coupons for this attraction♪”

text_block_list.name: Creepy Receptionist
text_block_list.text:
If you come together with a first-time customer,
we'll make it even cheaper, so please come again—boo-hoo-hoo!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ummm............ thanks?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
So basically... the whole curse thing
was just part of the act, right?
choice_data_list: That's less of a curse and more of a blessing, honestly.
That's less of a curse and more of a blessing, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what's that supposed to mean!
Though, that did help me relax a bit.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
If it's a curse like that, I welcome it anytime.
Let's go again, Trainer!
